definitions.explanation: The act of not eating for a period of time, whether for medical, religious, or protest purposes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{絶食|ぜっしょく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{抗議|こうぎ}→抗議：12807_kougi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{三日間|みっかかん}{絶食|ぜっしょく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They fasted for three days in protest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{絶食|ぜっしょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{点滴|てんてき}→点滴：10580_tenteki⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{摂|と}っていた→摂る：29372_toru⟧。
examples.english: Fasting was required after the surgery, and nutrition was taken only through an IV drip.

notes:
Composed of {絶|ぜつ} (to cut off, cease) + {食|しょく} (food, eating). Refers to complete abstention from food, as opposed to simply skipping a meal. Most commonly encountered in medical contexts (pre-surgery or pre-examination fasting) and in references to hunger strikes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絶食|ぜっしょく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to fast
- {絶食|ぜっしょく}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧ — state of fasting
- {絶食|ぜっしょく}ストライキ — hunger strike
- {絶食|ぜっしょく}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧ — fasting period

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {断食|だんじき} — fasting; often used for religious or health-motivated fasting
- {欠食|けっしょく} — skipping a meal; less severe than complete fasting
- ファスティング — fasting; loanword used in health/diet contexts
